title: T1.3: cli.rs — TypeAction, EpicAction, Invocation variants, parsers, flags

text:
Requirements: R12, R13, R14, R15, R16, R29. Files: src/cli.rs.
AC: TypeAction enum (List, Add, Remove); EpicAction enum (List, Show, Create, Add); Invocation::Type and ::Epic variants; story_type on New/List/SetFields; parse_invocation dispatches "type" and "epic"; --type flag on new/list/set; parse_type follows parse_state pattern; parse_epic parses all subcommands; HELP_TEXT updated; existing cli::tests pass; new parser tests.
